page.layout: Two columns of index entries on one printed page, left column then right column. Both are read top to bottom. A letter "H." stands as a line in the left column. No headings, no marginal notes. Pen marks in the margins are handwriting and are left out. Running head at the top centre. Catchword "hypo-" at the lower right.
page.notes: The "&" after "opibus" is an ornamental ampersand whose reading is doubtful, so it is marked [?]. The "A" of "Aeretici" is printed as a large initial "H" with "Aeretici" following; it is joined as "HAeretici" as the printed letters show. The hyphen in "uiri-"/"bus" and the other line-end hyphens are kept as printed. Handwritten pen marks (numerals and ticks in the margins, and a mark beside "homines") are not transcribed. The top-line running head is set with letter spacing and ends in a colon as printed.
